proposals.description: The existing registry denotes the named commercial Difco Marine Broth 2216 preparation. The manufacturer manual, printed pages 351-352, independently lists broth and agar formulas: broth has magnesium chloride 5.9 g and magnesium sulfate 3.24 g per litre at standard reconstitution; agar has magnesium chloride 8.8 g and sodium sulfate 3.24 g. Thus the products do not differ only by agar. The corrected sixteen-part commercial broth formula is retained; unspecified salt forms remain UNMAPPED. The old MIM curation (#260) assertion and ATCC agar-minus-agar transcription are historical provenance, not the active identity basis. This source-bound correction does not merge generic marine-medium owners or resolve worker03 same-owner alias reconciliation. The manufacturer labels the printed broth table an approximate formula per litre and permits adjustment or supplementation to meet performance criteria. COMPLETE covers all 16 nominal printed dry-product inputs, not exact chemical closure for every manufactured lot. The existing component names and quantities remain unchanged on their standard-reconstitution basis; water remains outside the dry product, and unspecified salt forms and generic Peptone remain unresolved. No extra ingredient, lot-specific adjustment or forced PARTIAL status is inferred. Under the filed COMBINED37-COMPONENT-GROUNDING-001 follow-up, each printed component was assessed separately. Supported existing MIM material references are added for Sodium chloride, Potassium chloride, Sodium bicarbonate, Potassium bromide, Boric acid, Sodium fluoride, Ammonium nitrate. All literal names, nominal amounts and units are retained. Other entries remain UNMAPPED for the specific form, processing or product prerequisites recorded in the source ledger; there is no blanket unspecified-salt rule or whole-owner approval.
